## Summary

Current work includes a full-size pinball machine, an AI-vision robotics arm, a self-watering planter PCB, and a subpixel image editor.

## Main Projects

### Garden Party Pinball
Status: In progress
Context: Solo
Label: pinball machine
My role: I am building the cabinet, playfield systems, wiring, MPF configuration, and test setup.
A full-size homebrew pinball machine using FAST boards, Mission Pinball Framework, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and a revised playfield.
Published media: 2

### VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm
Status: Completed team project
Context: Team of 10, Stanford AI4ALL
Label: robotics simulation
Source: https://github.com/LenekyRadish/VividGrasp
Best link label: Open source
My role: Head CAD designer; prepared URDF files and worked with a teammate on a physical prototype.
Related program/logo link: https://ai4all.spcs.stanford.edu/
A Stanford AI4ALL team project connecting SolidWorks CAD, STL export, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target input, and robotic-arm motion.
Published media: 4

### Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB
Status: Prototype in progress
Context: Solo
Label: plant-watering prototype
My role: I worked on the sensing and control concept, electronics packaging, PCB direction, and enclosure constraints.
A plant-watering prototype involving moisture sensing, pump control, electronics packaging, enclosure planning, and PCB work.
Published media: 4; interactive 3D models: 1

### Subpix
Status: Functional v1
Context: Solo
Label: desktop app
Project: https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix
Best link label: Open app
My role: Built the editor, file-format flow, export path, product site, and Windows packaging.
An open-source Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript desktop app for editing .subpix files, validating JSON data, exporting PNGs, and packaging for Windows.
Published media: 2
